# vergeio_tenant_node_device (Resource)

Attaches a host device to a tenant node. VergeOS stores the row in `machine_devices` against the node's machine key, not the tenant node key. Passing the device to the tenant creates a resource group inside the tenant that its VMs then consume.

The device is thick provisioned. The tenant owns it even when no VM inside the tenant is using it, so it cannot be assigned to another VM or tenant until this resource is destroyed.

`resource_group` is the resource group UUID, the same value as an id from [`vergeio_resource_groups`](../data-sources/resource_groups.html). `type` has to be one of `node_usb_devices`, `tpm`, `node_pci_devices`, `node_nvidia_vgpu_devices`, `node_host_gpu_devices`, `node_sriov_nic_devices`, `gpu`, or `nvidia_vgpu`. `gpu` and `nvidia_vgpu` are the older names. Changing `tenant_node_id` or `type` replaces the device.

`device_count` is how many copies VergeOS creates. It is sent as `count`. Terraform reserves `count`, so the argument cannot use that name. It defaults to 1 and is only sent when the device is created. The device row does not store the number, so Terraform keeps the configured value. Changing it replaces the device. Every copy is listed in `device_ids`, and destroy removes all of them.

`enabled` defaults to true. `optional` defaults to false. When `optional` is true, the tenant node can start without the device. `name`, `description`, `resource_group`, `enabled`, and `optional` update in place. Omit `description` or `resource_group` to leave the current value unchanged.

[`vergeio_tenant_node_devices`](../data-sources/tenant_node_devices.html) lists every device on the node, including ones this configuration did not create.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pass one host device to a tenant node.
# resource_group is the resource group UUID from vergeio_resource_groups.
# The tenant owns the device once it is attached, even when no VM inside
# the tenant is using it. It cannot be assigned to another VM or tenant
# until this resource is destroyed.
# device_count is sent as count. It defaults to 1. Every copy is listed in
# device_ids, and destroy removes all of them.

data "vergeio_resource_groups" "passthrough" {
  filter_name = "GPU"
}

resource "vergeio_tenant_node_device" "gpu" {
  tenant_node_id = vergeio_tenant_node.example.id
  name           = "gpu0"
  description    = "GPU for the tenant"
  type           = data.vergeio_resource_groups.passthrough.resource_groups[0].type
  resource_group = data.vergeio_resource_groups.passthrough.resource_groups[0].id
  device_count   = 1
  optional       = false
  enabled        = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Device name. VergeOS requires a name.
- `tenant_node_id` (String) Key of the parent `vergeio_tenant_node`. Changing it replaces the device.
- `type` (String) Device type: `node_usb_devices`, `tpm`, `node_pci_devices`, `node_nvidia_vgpu_devices`, `node_host_gpu_devices`, `node_sriov_nic_devices`, `gpu`, or `nvidia_vgpu`. `gpu` and `nvidia_vgpu` are the older names. Changing it replaces the device.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Device description. Omit to leave the current description unchanged.
- `device_count` (Number) How many copies VergeOS creates. Sent as `count` on create only. Defaults to 1. The device row does not store this number, so Terraform keeps the configured value. Changing it replaces the device. Every copy is listed in `device_ids`, and destroy removes all of them.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the device is enabled. Defaults to true.
- `optional` (Boolean) When true, the tenant node can start without this device. Defaults to false.
- `resource_group` (String) Resource group UUID, the same value as a `vergeio_resource_groups` id. This is the `resource_group` stored on the device. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.

### Read-Only

- `created` (Number) Creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `device_ids` (List of String) `machine_devices` keys created with this device. A copy has the same type and a name of this device or `name-N`. Destroy removes every key.
- `id` (String) `machine_devices` key assigned by VergeOS.
- `machine` (Number) Machine key of the tenant node. VergeOS stores the device against this key, not the tenant node key.
- `machine_type` (String) Machine kind stored on the device. A tenant node device is `tenant`.
- `modified` (Number) Last modification time as a Unix timestamp.
- `orderid` (Number) Device order, from 0 through 64.
- `uuid` (String) Device UUID assigned by VergeOS.

## Import

Import is supported using the machine_devices key.

```shell
terraform import vergeio_tenant_node_device.example <id>
```
